cover.headline: We're investing in you, decoded
cover.sub: Why label investment comes back out of your royalties, and how to invest in yourself.

blocks.text: Recording, videos and marketing are often **recoupable**. The label spends now and takes it back from your share later.
Get every recoupable cost listed in writing.

left.title: Investor
left.text: Owns a stake and shares the risk if it fails.

right.title: Label
right.text: Recoups from your share and may own the masters.

blocks.text: Ask for the unrecouped balance on every royalty statement.
Start with what pays back fastest: an **email list**, a presale, one bundle. Each one funds the next.
Put a fixed share of every release's income back into the list and the store.
A presale is fans paying up front for something they want. **No interest, no recoupment, no terms.**
Run your next presale three weeks before release and use it to pay for the record.
